notes.title: v1.2 Update
notes.content:
[b]Hi there, collectors,[/b]

It’s been more than a week, and we have already come a long way. First of all, we want to thank you for all the support. We hope to grow bigger and better to create even more exciting games for you all.



[h1]Let's talk about the update.[/h1]

The v1.2 update is the first update that adds new gameplay mechanics and a new item.






[h2]New Item - EMF Device ![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45211746/fb7990ecf9c416928328d046a3feae45d68c0ccc.png[/img]


This new item, as the name suggests, is an EMF (Electromagnetic Field) Meter Device that captures the electromagnetic field around the haunted objects we need to collect.

When you get close to a haunted object, you will receive a visual response depending on your distance to the object. The lights will turn on and sound cues will alert you as you approach.

Keep in mind that it only detects the closest object, so if there’s another object in the same room, keep searching!





[h1]List of changes&fixes[/h1]


[b]• The biggest change is that we have completely overhauled the item interaction system. Now, you can only collect items if you look directly at them, as it should have been from the beginning.
[/b]


• Some texts now have corrected fonts.
• New hints about the EMF device have been added.
• Entrance signs have been added outside the manor to make it easier to find.
• The inventory system has been completely remade and now works without any issues.
• Footstep sounds have been added for Mr. Charveil outside the manor.
• The flashlight now turns off and on during the hunting sequence. This makes it easier for players to 
  understand when the ghost has started the hunt.



We received a lot of feedback from players about their inability to identify the objects they needed to collect. In this update, we primarily addressed that by introducing a new item to help with finding them. With this addition, we also completely remade the inventory system. Additionally, we did a complete overhaul of the item interaction system.


Thanks to all the feedback that helped us identify these issues. If you have any feedback or suggestions, you can join our Discord or send them directly to us via email.





[h2]Northstar Games[/h2]

notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.content:
[b]Hi there, collectors,

It's been an excellent launch week for all of us. First of all, we thank you for all the support. We hope to grow bigger and better in order to create bigger and better games for you all.


Let's talk about the update.

The v1.1 update is mainly based on your feedback and includes new additions.
[/b]




[h1][b]New Additions ![/b][/h1]


• Startup logo animations have been added.

• We now have a cinematic opening sequence that tells the story and how we got here.

• We also have lights scattered around the forest that lead to Rosefield Manor.

• Hints have been added to the Objective UI.



[h2][b]List of changes&fixes[/b][/h2]


• Sanity text has been added to the top of the sanity bar.
• New hints have been added.
• Some lightning bugs have now been fixed.
• Loading screens are now smoother.
• Startup logo animations are now skippable.


One of the big issues was players not being able to find Rosefield Manor easily. In this update, we addressed that. Now we have lights and paths that lead to the manor.

Thanks to all the feedback that helped us identify these issues. If you have any feedback or suggestions, you can join our Discord or send them directly to us via email.





[h3][b]Northstar Games[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Haunting: The Rosefield Manor is OUT !
notes.content:
[b]Hi there Collectors, 


Launch of the Haunting: The Rosefield Manor is here ! 

This update is mainly about announcing our Launch and Several fixes with changes.


First of all thanks for all the collectors out there who wishlisted our game on steam. We continue to develop our game thanks to all of you. We hope to get bigger and better only to create bigger and better games for you all.


Lets talk about the update, [/b]




[h2][b]New Additions ![/b][/h2]


• Mr. Charveil outside the house now has an axe.

• Old car now have proper textures assigned.

• Some models of the furnitures changed.

• Flashlight model is now updated.



[h1][b]List of changes&fixes [/b][/h1]


• Some furnitures in the manor is now have correct collisions.
• Flashlight's light is corrected.
• Some texture bugs now fixed.
• Loading screen causing crash is now fixed.
• Old car's engine sound is replaced.
• Fixed some movement bugs.
• Character collisions no longer causes AI to stop moving.

~ and many more QoL changes has been made.


Thanks for all the support, We always look forward to bring you better experience.



[h1][b]Northstar Games[/b][/h1]
